bead.title: routing: fail over to available candidates when default_provider endpoint is unreachable (no route_resolution_timeout)
bead.description:
PROBLEM: For an unpinned request (no --harness/--provider/--model), when `default_provider` names an endpoint that is unreachable (e.g. local lmstudio down → 502 / connection refused), routing stalls and fails with `route_resolution_timeout: route resolution exceeded 1m0s` instead of failing over to other available candidates (e.g. subscription harnesses claude/codex). Observed 2026-05-28 when the local model fleet was down: all three project workers (ddx/fizeau/helix) could not execute.

ROOT CAUSE: selectConfiguredNativeProvider (service_native_provider.go:80-86) returns the configured DefaultProviderName() unconditionally for the `req.Provider=="" && wantedType==""` branch, with NO dispatchability/health check. The dead endpoint is then pinned and the route stalls until the 1m timeout. Per spec (docs/routing/index.md:15) hard gates are limited to explicit user constraints and dispatchability — a known-unreachable default_provider is a dispatchability failure, not an implicit pin.

PROPOSED FIX: in selectConfiguredNativeProvider (or its caller in service_native_provider.go / service_routing.go), consult the same reachability signals the engine uses (ProviderUnreachable / ProbeUnreachable). When the default provider is known-unreachable, skip the native-default selection and fall through to engine auto-routing so an available candidate (subscription harness or other reachable provider) is selected.

NON-SCOPE: do not change candidate scoring; do not change default_provider behavior when the default IS reachable; do not touch the catalog.
bead.acceptance:
1. New test TestDefaultProviderFailsOverWhenUnreachable (fizeau, service_native_provider/service_routing package): given default_provider set to an unreachable endpoint AND an available subscription-harness candidate, ResolveRoute selects the available candidate (not the dead default) and returns no error / no timeout.
2. TestDefaultProviderUsedWhenReachable (new or existing): when the default provider IS reachable, it is still selected for the unpinned native path (no behavior regression).
3. ResolveRoute returns no route_resolution_timeout whenever at least one dispatchable candidate exists.
4. cd /Users/erik/Projects/fizeau && go test ./... green.
5. lefthook run pre-commit passes.
